title: Last Stand Critical - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Last Stand Critical in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Last Stand Critical is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Gain Critical if fighting alone.

sections.title: How to Get Last Stand Critical
Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
